safety_rules: Treat this JSON as a declarative migration plan; do not execute destructive deletion directly from it.
Run a dry-run validator before any move.
Use git mv for tracked paths when possible; preserve untracked/generated data with filesystem moves plus checksums.
Move phase 20 reveal/unblind material first and exclude 09_archive/D_private_reveal from all BLIND package creation.
Do not overwrite an existing destination. Destination collisions must abort and require review.
Before moving KnotPlot/datasets, introduce a central SST_WORKBENCH_ROOT/SST_DATA_ROOT/SST_KNOT_DATASET resolver so relative dataset paths do not silently break.
After each research-family move, run its installation/build/basic test before declaring the old path retired.
Preserve the existing SST falsifier output naming convention and BLIND/REVEALED separation.
No Python import/package names are changed merely because a containing filesystem directory is renamed.
Archive-only content inside Restore_Archives is preserved transitively; this max-depth tree does not enumerate every archive filename.
